title.narrative: ID: Learning, Acting and Building for Rehabilitation in Health Systems (ReLAB-HS)

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): This activity's overall goal is to support the development of health systems that are responsive to growing needs for rehabilitation across the lifespan. The activity will focus on service delivery and workforce strengthening, policy and prioritization, drivers to integrate rehabilitation in health systems, building an understanding on rehabilitation, and conducting and sharing research, evaluations, and learning.. In addition, the activity will continue to fund and provide technical assistance to accelerator grants to support sustainability of efforts. In line with the National Security Strategy and the Joint Strategic Plan, the activity helps to ensure accountability to U.S. taxpayers by strengthening local systems to support the sustainability of development investments and address barriers to equal access and opportunity. This IM implements the Leahy War Victim Fund directive/earmark.
